title: EPFO Rolls Out Centralised CITES 2.01 Platform for 340 Million Member Accounts
summary: Migrates 120 decentralised databases into a single national system for automated claim processing.

blocks.content: Migrates 120 decentralised databases into a single national system for automated claim processing.

items: Database Migration: Unified CITES 2.01 platform consolidates 340 million accounts across 120 databases.
Auto-Settlement Threshold: Auto-settlement limit for KYC-compliant advance claims raised from ₹1 lakh to ₹5 lakh.
PF Interest Crediting: Enables crediting of 2025-26 PF interest by July 15 ahead of traditional schedule.

blocks.title: Static Background & GK Context
blocks.summary: Central Board of Trustees (CBT) approved CITES platform | EPFO HQ: New Delhi.

blocks.title: Exam Trap & Statutory Distinction
blocks.content: Auto-settlement limit (₹5 lakh, up from ₹1 lakh) vs 3-day settlement mandate.
